unit: NZD/m² building floor area, GST exclusive

band.unit: NZD/m² building floor area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of distinct ground-treatment components: shallow 1 m replacement proxy ($80 + $126 + $12.80) through deeper TC3 imported-fill proxy ($90 + $287 + $36.20), plus a minor setup allowance of $10–$30/m². Physical ground improvement only; assumes treatment across the building footprint. Foundations and structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, formal testing and construction monitoring, and repairs to existing damage are excluded. Not a certified price.

band.unit: NZD/m² of building floor area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of the distinct excavation, replacement fill, geogrid and minor allowance components. Cost-plan proxy assumes 0.75–1.5m-deep excavate-and-replace treatment with one geogrid layer. Assumes construction-only ground improvement; excludes foundations and structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, repairs, construction testing and monitoring. The allowance is a minor share of the total; low confidence reflects unknown method, depth, footprint and site conditions.

band.unit: NZD/m² of building floor area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of the three distinct QV ground-replacement components above. Assumes shallow excavation and replacement with compacted GAP65 and geogrid, with treatment depth varied from 0.75 m to 1.5 m. The centre is the midpoint of the resulting range. Excludes foundations, structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, and repairs. Also assumes testing and construction monitoring are excluded. This is a working cost-plan rate, not a certified price. Liquefaction vulnerability is mapped across Christchurch, but it varies by location and ground conditions; the city map divides Christchurch into 600 areas with similar ground conditions. The viewer states: “Providing coverage of the entire Christchurch City territorial land area.” Source: source-2, https://apps.canterburymaps.govt.nz/ChristchurchLiquefactionViewer/
